notes: MARS_MESH is ONE connected component and carries NO hair bones -- every lock is rigid-skinned to 'head'. An island-split or one-bone-per-strand rig is structurally impossible.
The crown is a fused shell; the hanging lengths resolve into ~20-25 sculpted locks. Both true of one surface, which is why no global threshold separated it.
